params.body:
## What

On the Accounts page, in the members of gentells.com section:

- **Add a test account**: a plain form like "Add someone to the team" above it, with name, email, a plan picked from the plans the site lists, and a trial length (none, 7, 14 or 30 days). It posts to the pipeline's new `POST /site/accounts`.
- On success the sign-in link stays on screen with a Copy button until it is put away, with a line that says whether the mail went out ("Mail did not go out, so share this link yourself" otherwise) and until when the link works.
- Accounts made this way read "test account, made <date>" under the address in the list, so they can be found and ended later.
- In Recent changes, the creation reads "<who> made a test account for <address>, on <plan>" instead of "changed the created of".

## Why

Editorial can change plans, trials and access on gentells.com from here, but could not set up an account for a prospect or a client who should try Gentells. The link is the handover whether or not mail is configured, so it is shown and copyable rather than only mailed. The person chooses their own password through it; none passes through the Observatory.

## Tests

- `npm run build`: passed.
- `npx eslint src/pages/Accounts.jsx`: no findings.
- The repo has no test runner.

Merge after the site and pipeline PRs.

Refs Trendwolves/gentells-site#223
